intermediate.name: Col du Noyer
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) Col du Noyer (25.2 km)

story: In Stage 19 of the 2026 Tour de France, a 43-rider breakaway formed early. Mads Pedersen strengthened his green jersey lead, while Valentin Paret-Peintre and Richard Carapaz contested polka dot points. On Alpe d'Huez, Lenny Martinez, Carapaz, and Sepp Kuss attacked repeatedly but stayed together. Tadej Pogačar launched an early attack, bridged to the leaders, and won the stage, breaking Marco Pantani's climbing record with a time of 35:26.
